title: isPrime
description:
Write `bool isPrime(int n)`. A prime is a whole number greater than 1 that only divides evenly by 1 and itself.

Try every possible divisor from 2 upwards. As soon as one divides evenly you can `return false` straight away. You only need to try divisors up to the square root of `n`, which you can write without any maths library as `d * d <= n`.
hints: Deal with the small cases first: anything below 2 is not prime.
Then loop `for (int d{ 2 }; d * d <= n; ++d)` and `return false` as soon as `n % d == 0`. If the loop finishes without finding a divisor, the number is prime.
